estimators.census: per (W, arm): the mean over the run's rounds of exact system-call counts and byte totals, summed over the W worker processes (mean_workers) and over every traced process (mean_process_tree); no interval, no ratio
estimators.pages: bytes of brk growth or shrink divided by 4,096
estimators.trace_lines: 299823 calls on one line and 1166205 split by strace -f into an unfinished and a resumed line, 0 unparsed; both forms are counted
estimators.correction: recounted from the run's own traces: the first published version counted whole-line calls only, which understated every brk call count and, by about 1%, the page totals
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, one row per process tree
estimators.thp: 1 of 36 smaps sample files were unreadable and carry thp: null

provenance.diagnostic: an engine increment against its merge base and stock, outside METHODOLOGY.md's pre-registration (docs/BENCHMARKING.md, the increment's pre-registration)

diagnostic_settings.per_delete: a process's whole-run counter divided by its deletes, bogo-ops x 4,194,304; the insert and find phases are in the numerator
diagnostic_settings.wrapper: a host-side wrapper, not in the repository, filters driver.cells() to these cells, passes perf_events to driver.run_one, and calls diag_increment.main()
diagnostic_settings.run_number: a scratch number under the 8e6d2edc7 prefix; runs 1 and 2 are the second record's pair
diagnostic_settings.census: untimed: every process also ran under strace -f -qq -e trace=brk,mmap,munmap,madvise,mremap, and its stress-ng descendants' /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup was sampled every 50 ms; stress-ng's rates from these processes are not published
